_note: Dated, event-anchored chart series (rule #1: real dates + real/editorial values only, no fabricated fill). Consumed by src/js/app.js EventSeriesChart via window.__DATA__. ww3_milestones are the pre-daily-tracking historical anchors (each {d,v} is a real reporting date + the editorial WW3% at that date); scripts/build.js merges them with the dated daily escalation_history.json (Jun 24 -> now) into __DATA__.ww3_series. brent/hormuz/gas_nat are honest-sparse dated anchors from documented reporting; the live tail is spliced client-side and the series densify as the daily pipeline appends. Direction (red=escalating / green=de-escalating) is DERIVED from the value delta at render time; the k field is documentation only. To add a milestone going forward, append a dated {d,v,t,s} row here. AUDIT 2026-11-07: milestones before 2026-05-19 (the first day the four sub-axes were scored) were re-scored by applying the methodology bands to a verified fact sheet; they are reconstructions, not same-day scores. Day 0 moved from 10 (rung "no kinetic") to 55: the opening strike killed Khamenei and Iran hit US bases in seven states. Five labels were corrected or dropped (House vote Mar 5 not Mar 4; IAEA-exit, first-naval-death and Mar 22 mining events not found; the tanker seizure was May 8). From 2026-05-19 the chart uses the scored daily record. Axis breakdowns are in the private methodology file.
